toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search code, task, person… or type /

search.filtering: The table is filtered by your search. Pick a result to jump to it.

sync.errorDetail: Could not write data: {{msg}}. Your changes are kept in memory and will be retried.

views.needFilter: Set a filter or search before saving

gantt.hint: Click a day to open its 24-hour timeline

timeline.title: Timeline for {{date}}
timeline.empty: No scheduled tasks on this day

tip.hint: Click to pin · Double-click to open

del.title: Delete tasks
del.messageSimple: This deletes {{n}} daily tasks. Are you sure?
del.messageTuan: This deletes {{n}} weekly tasks and {{d}} daily tasks. Are you sure?
del.messageThang: This deletes {{n}} monthly tasks with {{w}} weekly and {{d}} daily tasks. Are you sure?

form.errDeadline: The deadline can't be before the start date
form.errActualEnd: The actual end can't be before the actual start
form.errBothTimes: Enter both planned times, or leave both empty
form.errTimeOrder: The end time can't be before the start time
form.errActualStartFirst: Enter the actual start time first

drawer.actualHint: Leave actual dates empty to calculate them from subtasks.
drawer.ngayHint: An actual end time marks the task Done; only a start time marks it In progress.

toast.pickMe: Choose "I am…" in Settings to use My tasks

restore.title: Restore data
restore.preview: This imports {{m}} monthly, {{w}} weekly, {{d}} daily tasks and {{p}} people. Your current data is backed up before it is replaced.
restore.future: This file comes from a newer HCN version. Update the app first.

notice.restored: data.json was damaged, so it was restored from backup {{file}}
notice.corrupt: data.json was damaged and no backup exists. The damaged file was kept as {{file}}

notify.title: HCN: {{over}} overdue, {{soon}} due soon
notify.hint: On launch and every 4 hours, HCN sends one summary of overdue and due-soon tasks not yet notified today.

people.hint: People are used to assign tasks and show avatars on the Gantt.
people.name: Name
people.empty: No one yet. Add the first person above.
people.deleteAssigned: {{name}} is assigned to {{n}} tasks. They will become "Unassigned".
people.duplicate: That name is already in the list

personal.hint: Used by the "My tasks" filter and as the default owner for new tasks.

data.backupHint: Save a .json backup, restore from a .json file (including backups from the old HTML version), or export a 4-sheet Excel file.
data.locationHint: Data lives outside the install folder, so updating or reinstalling keeps it. Automatic backups are in the backups folder.
data.legacyTitle: Move data from the old HTML version
data.legacyHint: Open the old HTML version, click Backup to get a cvkt-backup-….json file, then use Restore from .json above.
data.androidLocation: Data is stored in the app's private storage on this phone. Uninstalling the app deletes it, so sync with your PC or back up to .json first.

update.devNote: Development build: update checks only work in the installed app.
update.androidNote: On Android, update by installing the new .apk over the old one. Your data is kept.

wifi.unavailable: Sync is only available in the PC and Android apps.
wifi.hubHint: This PC acts as the hub: phones on the same Wi-Fi send and receive changes while the PC app is open. Data never leaves your local network.
wifi.enable: Allow phones to sync over Wi-Fi
wifi.addressesHint: Enter this address on the phone. If there are several, use the one on the phone's Wi-Fi (usually starting with 192.168).
wifi.noAddress: This PC isn't connected to Wi-Fi or a wired network.
wifi.codeHint: Each code works once. It changes automatically after a phone pairs.
wifi.noDevices: No phones yet. Open HCN on the phone, go to Settings > Sync and enter the address and code above.
wifi.removeMsg: {{name}} won't be able to sync until it pairs again. Data on the phone stays.
wifi.firewall: The first time, Windows may ask for firewall access for HCN Work Manage: choose Allow for Private networks. The phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
wifi.clientHint: On the PC, open HCN > Settings > Sync, turn sync on, then enter the address and code shown there. The phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
wifi.auto: Syncs automatically on open, after changes and every 30 seconds while on the same Wi-Fi as a PC running HCN. Elsewhere it works normally and syncs when you're back.
wifi.unpairMsg: The phone stops syncing with the PC. Data on both devices is kept.

err.code: The pairing code is wrong or already used. Check the new code on the PC.
err.unpaired: The PC removed this phone. Pair again.
err.tooMany: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in a minute.
err.network: Can't reach the PC. Check: same Wi-Fi, HCN open on the PC with sync on, correct address.
err.timeout: The PC didn't respond in time. Try again with a better Wi-Fi signal.
err.schema: The devices use different data versions. Update the app on both.
err.server: The PC reported an error. Try again later.
